name: redesign
description: Run UI/UX screenshots through many AI models and collect reimagined HTML prototypes.

scripts.//build: bun installs src/web (the machine-global isolated linker + global store keeps node_modules as links instead of a second real copy, see ~/.bunfig.toml); vite still runs under node. CI and scripts/build.ts deliberately use `npm ci` from package-lock.json instead: a cold runner has no warm store and no global bun config, and the release artifact should come from the committed npm lockfile. Both layouts are verified to build and to pass the vitest suite.
scripts.build: bun install --cwd src/web && npm --prefix src/web run build
scripts.build:web:locked: npm --prefix src/web ci && npm --prefix src/web run build
scripts.//check:web: src/web's own verification lanes: vue-tsc over both tsconfigs, the i18n key check, and vitest. CI's `web` job runs the same three, but no LOCAL gate did, so a green `bun run check` said nothing about the web app while its suite could be red. a `bun run` delegation with `--cwd` rather than `npm` with `--prefix`: both run the same script from src/web with that directory's node_modules/.bin on PATH, and the npm-vs-bun parent makes no difference to the toolchain (measured 2026-09-16 on this tree - vue-tsc clean on both tsconfigs, vitest 243/243) - but the verification-coverage-reachability oracle walks package scripts by following a `--cwd <dir>` edge and cannot parse `--prefix`, so under npm the three lanes read as reached by no gate and are reported as scripts that verify NOTHING. The flag must follow `run`: written the other way round, with the directory flag ahead of `run`, it is not a flag bun knows there, so it matches no script and prints the script list instead, exit 0 - a silent no-op, not an error.
scripts.check:web: bun run --cwd src/web typecheck && bun run --cwd src/web check:i18n && bun run --cwd src/web test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:kit && bun run check:web
scripts.//check:local: Checks that CANNOT run on GitHub, so localci runs them on the host instead. check:kit compares this app's kit-managed copies against lunarwerx-ui, a PRIVATE sibling repo a public repo's CI can never check out. Without this its only enforcement is the pre-commit hook, which --no-verify skips and which silently no-ops on any machine without the sibling checkout.
